name: Dianchungosaurus
sum: Dianchungosaurus is a mesoeucrocodylian crocodyliform from the Early Jurassic Lufeng Formation of China, once thought to be a dinosaur.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Lufeng Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Young 1982
